## [OVERVIEW]
Medusa's native promotion eligibility rules cover only static attributes: region, sales channel, currency, and customer group. This plugin extends Medusa's promotion engine with cart-state rules — minimum subtotal, item/collection quantities, per-customer usage caps, first-order status — without replacing Medusa's discount calculation. Merchants create promotions normally in Medusa admin, then attach custom rule sets via a plugin widget on the promotion detail page or via REST API. Rules are enforced at three lifecycle points: synchronously when a promo code is entered (Layer 1), asynchronously after any cart mutation (Layer 2 auto-apply), and synchronously at checkout (Layer 3). Designed for hundreds of clients and thousands of promotions — uses a normalized 3-table DB schema so `auto_apply` can be filtered at the SQL level.

## [INSTALL]
Requires: Node.js 20+, @medusajs/medusa 2.14.2, PostgreSQL
```bash
yarn add @retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension
```
Register in medusa-config.ts:
```ts
import { defineConfig } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [{ resolve: "@retailos-ai/rms-promotions-extension" }],
})
```
Run migrations:
```bash
npx medusa db:migrate
```
**Required constraint:** every Medusa promotion managed by this plugin must have `is_automatic: false`. Setting `is_automatic: true` causes Medusa to unconditionally re-apply the promotion, bypassing all plugin rules.

## [QUICKSTART]
```bash
# Create config (auto-apply when rules pass)
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_id": "promo_abc", "auto_apply": true }'
# → { "promotion_ext_config": { "id": "pec_001" } }

# Create include rule group
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "promotion_config_id": "pec_001", "type": "include" }'
# → { "promotion_ext_rule_group": { "id": "perg_001" } }

# Add rule: auto-apply when subtotal >= 300
curl -X POST /admin/promotion-ext-rules \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "rule_group_id": "perg_001", "rule_type": "comparison", "config": { "field": "subtotal", "operator": "gte", "value": 300 } }'
```
Promotion is now auto-applied to any cart with subtotal ≥ 300, and removed when it drops below.

## [USAGE]

### Rule fields (rule_type: "comparison")
Each rule: `{ rule_type: "comparison", config: { field, operator, value, scope? } }`

subtotal: number — Cart item subtotal pre-discount. Operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte. No scope.
totalQuantity: number — Total item count in cart. Operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte. No scope.
quantityOfProduct: number — Qty of a specific product. Operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte. Scope: `{ product_id }` required.
quantityOfCollection: number — Qty from a collection. Operators: eq neq gt gte lt lte. Scope: `{ collection_id }` required.
usesPerCustomer: number — Times customer used this promotion (non-cancelled/refunded orders). Operators: lt lte only. No scope.
firstOrder: boolean — Customer has zero prior orders. Operator: eq only. Value: true|false. No scope.
Guest carts (no customer_id): usesPerCustomer and firstOrder rules pass unconditionally (optimistic — same as Medusa native behavior for customer groups).

### Combinators
rules_combinator on each rule group: "and" (default) | "or" — joins rules within the group.
include_groups_combinator on the config: "or" (default) | "and" — joins include groups together.
Defaults produce DNF (any group triggers, all rules in a group must pass) — same model as Braze, Segment, Shopify.

Example — cart between 100–500:
```json
{
  "include_groups_combinator": "or",
  "rule_groups": [{
    "type": "include", "rules_combinator": "and",
    "rules": [
      { "rule_type": "comparison", "config": { "field": "subtotal", "operator": "gte", "value": 100 } },
      { "rule_type": "comparison", "config": { "field": "subtotal", "operator": "lte", "value": 500 } }
    ]
  }]
}
```

### auto_apply flag
auto_apply: true — Layer 2 (cart.updated subscriber) adds/removes promotion automatically.
auto_apply: false (default) — code-only; customer must enter code; rules still enforced at entry and checkout.
Safe default: any non-true value means code-only (fail-closed design).

### Exclusion groups (draft, API-only)
Create a rule group with `type: "exclude"` to suppress a promotion even when include groups pass.
exclude_groups_combinator on config controls how multiple exclude groups are joined ("or" default).
Not exposed in admin UI. Read-only in widget summary. May be removed or promoted to full UI in a future version.

### Three-layer enforcement architecture
Layer 1 — Code Gate: updateCartPromotionsWorkflow.hooks.validate fires synchronously on ADD. Throws MedusaError (HTTP 400) if rules fail. Cart unchanged.
Layer 2 — Auto-Apply Engine: cart.updated subscriber fires asynchronously after HTTP response. Fetches auto_apply=true configs, evaluates rules, computes delta (toAdd/toRemove), calls updateCartPromotionsWorkflow. No loop: updateCartPromotionsWorkflow does not emit cart.updated.
Layer 3 — Checkout Gate: completeCartWorkflow.hooks.validate fires synchronously before order placement. Throws MedusaError (HTTP 400). Never mutates — validation only.
Layer 1 + Layer 2 are intentionally redundant: when Layer 2 ADDs a promotion, Layer 1 re-evaluates inside the same workflow call. Both use the same evaluator, so they always agree.

### Rule evaluator (src/lib/rule-evaluator.ts)
evaluatePromotion(config: PromotionExtConfigShape, cart: EnrichedCart): boolean
Pure function — no DB calls. Dispatches to evaluateComparisonRule for rule_type "comparison". Callers pre-fetch DB data (e.g. usesPerCustomer count) and inject it into EnrichedCart before calling.

### Cart enricher (src/lib/cart-enricher.ts)
buildEnrichedCart(cartId, promotionId, configShape, container): Promise<EnrichedCart>
Queries Medusa graph for cart items, looks up usesPerCustomer from order history if any rule uses that field.
passesNativeRules(promotion, cart): boolean — checks Medusa's 4 native rule attributes (region_id, sales_channel_id, currency_code, customer_group_id) using cart data already in memory.

## [API]
All endpoints are admin-only. All resources support single-item CRUD and /batch for bulk operations.

### /admin/promotion-ext-configs
GET    ?promotion_id=X              — fetch config with nested rule_groups and their rules
POST                                — body: { promotion_id: string, auto_apply?: boolean }
PATCH  /:id                         — body: { auto_apply?: boolean, include_groups_combinator?: "and"|"or" }
DELETE /:id
POST   /batch                       — body: { items: [...] }
PATCH  /batch                       — body: { items: [{ id, ...fields }] }
DELETE /batch                       — body: { ids: string[] }

### /admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups
GET    ?promotion_config_id=X       — fetch all groups for a config
POST                                — body: { promotion_config_id: string, type: "include"|"exclude", rules_combinator?: "and"|"or" }
PATCH  /:id                         — body: { rules_combinator?: "and"|"or" }
DELETE /:id                         — cascades deletion of all rules in the group
POST   /batch                       — body: { items: [...] }
DELETE /batch                       — body: { ids: string[] }

### /admin/promotion-ext-rules
GET    ?rule_group_id[]=X&rule_group_id[]=Y   — fetch rules for one or more groups
POST                                — body: { rule_group_id: string, rule_type: "comparison", config: ComparisonRuleConfig }
PATCH  /:id                         — body: { rule_type?, config? }
DELETE /:id
POST   /batch                       — body: { items: [...] }
PATCH  /batch                       — body: { items: [{ id, ...fields }] }
DELETE /batch                       — body: { ids: string[] }

Validation errors (HTTP 400): unknown rule_type, invalid field/operator combo, missing scope for scoped fields, usesPerCustomer with non-lt/lte operator.

## [STRUCTURE]
src/admin/components/rules-editor/: Drawer-based rule editor — combinator-toggle.tsx, rule-group-card.tsx, rules-editor-form.tsx
src/admin/hooks/: React Query hooks — use-promotion-ext-config.ts, use-promotion-ext-rule-groups.ts, use-promotion-ext-rules.ts and mutation variants
src/admin/widgets/promotion-rules-widget.tsx: Medusa widget injected at promotion.details.after; hosts Drawer, Prompt (unsaved-changes guard), and read-only rule summary
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-configs/: route.ts, [id]/route.ts, batch/route.ts, validators.ts, middlewares.ts
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rule-groups/: same structure as configs
src/api/admin/promotion-ext-rules/: same structure as configs
src/lib/rule-evaluator.ts: pure evaluatePromotion() — all rule evaluation logic; no DB calls
src/lib/cart-enricher.ts: buildEnrichedCart(), passesNativeRules() — DB queries isolated here
src/modules/promotion-ext/models/promotion-ext-config.ts: DB entity with auto_apply, include_groups_combinator, exclude_groups_combinator
src/modules/promotion-ext/models/promotion-ext-rule-group.ts: DB entity with type ("include"|"exclude"), rules_combinator
src/modules/promotion-ext/models/promotion-ext-rule.ts: DB entity with rule_type discriminator and config JSONB
src/modules/promotion-ext/service.ts: MedusaService auto-generating CRUD for all 3 models
src/modules/promotion-ext/migrations/: DB migrations (Migration20260512131732, Migration20260518111622)
src/subscribers/cart-updated.ts: Layer 2 auto-apply engine
src/subscribers/validate-cart-promotions.ts: Layer 1 code gate
src/subscribers/validate-checkout.ts: Layer 3 checkout gate
src/subscribers/promotion-deleted.ts: deletes promotion_ext_config (and cascades) on promotion.deleted event
src/types/: TypeScript types for HTTP payloads and responses per resource
src/workflows/promotion-ext/: Medusa workflows (create/update/delete) for all 3 resources, used by API routes

## [DEPS]
@medusajs/framework 2.14.2: core Medusa utilities, MedusaService, query, workflow primitives
@medusajs/medusa 2.14.2: updateCartPromotionsWorkflow, completeCartWorkflow, addToCartWorkflow hooks
@medusajs/ui 4.1.9: Drawer, Prompt, ToggleGroup, and other admin UI components
@retailos-ai/rms-medusa-ui ^1.2.1: organization's custom Medusa UI package
react 19 / react-hook-form: admin widget form state and validation

        yarn test:integration:http         (integration tests — HTTP layer)
